notes: This contract pins the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador support-switch declarations implemented by the embedded development profile. It records API signatures, declared exception sets, source symbols, and real Catch2 integration selectors. Recipient-gated sent-region callback behavior is traced separately in convey-region-designator-callback-requirements-contract.json. The profile remains non-installable and does not claim complete connection-loss, MOM reporting, package evidence, protected review, or conformance.
